description: Finite target-aware AS2 EDU/Piper-H simulation candidates. Brochure ~20kg AS2 EDU including battery and Piper-H 2kg payload guide assumed endpoints only. Unknown real payload/mount/COM are not calibrated. Six named combinations, not a continuous/full target-domain guarantee.

parameter_ranges.status: Proposed target-domain stress candidates; no hardware capacity or successful pretraining claim. Uniform density hypothesis is deliberately distinct from placing missing mass at the base.

as2_mass_ratio.distribution_assumption: Multiply every positive-mass non-Piper body mass and COM inertia by the same ratio; geometry and COM locations unchanged. Independent base_mass_ratio remains additionally multiplicative.

leg_scale.meaning: All four hip/thigh/calf/foot links isotropic; mass multiplier as2_ratio*s^3 and inertia multiplier as2_ratio*s^5. Torso anchors unchanged.

piper_link_mass_ratios.meaning: Each positive-mass Piper link including gripper; AS2 density factor never affects Piper.

payload_mass_kg.meaning: 2kg brochure-based simulation stress endpoint; unknown real task payload. Zero collision geometry/own spin inertia; parallel-axis contribution retained. Not proof of rated fully extended control.

variants.name: nominal
variants.assumption: Unchanged source nominal AS2 17.640kg + Piper assembly 4.707kg; not identified EDU hardware.

variants.name: as2_density_20kg
variants.assumption: Uniform density scaling of every positive-mass non-Piper link maps source AS2 17.640kg to 20kg at nominal geometry. Research allocation, not measured battery or component masses.

variants.name: as2_density_20kg_tcp2kg
variants.assumption: Uniform 20kg-source-body hypothesis plus brochure-based 2kg TCP point-mass stress upper endpoint; no collision shape or rated full-extension guarantee.

variants.name: as2_density_20kg_tcp2kg_legs095
variants.assumption: Same source density factor and 2kg point stress load, then leg isotropic scaling at constant density. Actual AS2 mass changes with s^3; not a 20kg body after geometry scaling.

variants.name: as2_density_20kg_tcp2kg_legs105
variants.assumption: Same source density factor and 2kg point stress load, then leg isotropic scaling at constant density. Actual AS2 mass changes with s^3; not a 20kg body after geometry scaling.

variants.name: as2_density_20kg_tcp2kg_arm110
variants.assumption: Uniform source AS2 density hypothesis plus all Piper positive-mass links at 1.1 density and 2kg TCP point stress load. Arm increase is an uncalibrated research endpoint.
